title: 36 Hours in Madison, Wis.
abstract: Long pigeonholed as a hotbed for frat parties and activism, the town also has a vibrant side brimming with arts, culture and food.

title: 36 Hours in Aix-en-Provence
abstract: This sun-drenched town is a portrait of laid-back leisure. Museumgoers and market shoppers amble through charming streets and locals relax in celebrated spas.

title: 36 Hours in Cincinnati
abstract: The city is finding an artsy swagger, infused with a casual combination of Midwest and Southern charm.

title: 36 Hours on Martha’s Vineyard
abstract: Despite its popularity among the presidential set, the island is still a laid-back place with a lot of mopeds, fish shacks and nice beaches.

title: 36 Hours in Glasgow
abstract: Like the famously inscrutable dialect of its residents, this understatedly stylish city with its shopping districts and large green spaces is worth deciphering.
